description: Status, amounts, refund schedule, guest ID verification link, and when arrival details will be sent. Maps to GET /v1/bookings/{id}. Pass guest_email (the email the booking was made with) unless you connect with an agent token.

booking_id.description: The booking's id, from request_booking (starts with bkg_).

guest_email.description: The email the booking was made with. Needed unless you connect with an agent token.

name: get_booking

status.description: e.g. awaiting_payment, pending_host_confirmation, confirmed, declined, cancelled.

total.description: An amount in cents with its currency.

title: Get booking status
